title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01, 24-month proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.17 (po:4500013023-10) through EUR 5.24 (po:4500013392-10), EUR 5.43 (po:4500013795-10) to EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10) between 2025-10-06 and 2026-09-24. That rise is already in our price.

We would like to give you planning security. The attached packages cover 94,800 kg per year over 24 months at a fixed price, with no adjustment clause and no extra administrative work. One package also carries 60-day payment terms, matching our current contract ctr:4600070710.

In April your owner offered to walk us through your calculation. We would welcome that.

Which package suits you best?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01, 24-month proposal
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract, but we cannot fix prices for that duration and must apply an AS-14404 index clause. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.28 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Acknowledging your verified price history, we have adjusted our offer to €5.36 per unit for this 24-month indexed package with 30-day payment terms. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. We would be glad to arrange a meeting to walk you through our cost calculation as previously discussed. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – fixed-price package for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for accepting the 24-month term.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Your letter of 6 July (doc:20260706-70710-M1) states that your nickel and alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027. A fixed price therefore matches your own cost position, and it avoids the monthly adjustment workload on both sides.

The attached package covers 94,800 kg per year over 24 months, with 60-day payment terms as in ctr:4600070710.

Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant exists, for example a different bar length or delivery lot size?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – fixed-price package for 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our current offer is a price of €5.09 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. While our alloy costs are covered until March 2027, the 24-month contract duration extends well beyond this, making an AS-14404 index clause necessary. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: a price of €5.21 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our technical and delivery colleagues will reach out to you to discuss whether alternative bar lengths or lot sizes can offer further savings. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Part:370010 – revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for taking the forecast into account.

We have moved our price in the attached package. It keeps a fixed price for the full 24 months, so neither side carries the monthly adjustment workload. The package covers 94,800 kg per year over 24 months, with 60-day payment terms as in ctr:4600070710. As your letter doc:20260706-70710-M1 notes, your alloy cover runs into 2027. A fixed price therefore matches your own cost position for the start of the contract.

Thank you also for the notes on a cheaper grade and wider tolerances. Could you send the full list of those variants, so that our engineering team can review them?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part:370010 – revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. We are pleased to present our proposal, featuring our extensive stock and dedicated service.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer provides a price of €5.04 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.16 per unit.

Please provide figures quantifying the monthly adjustment workload you mentioned, so we can properly evaluate this concern.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
